The Traiana Harmony Trade Processing API provides cross-asset post-trade processing capabilities through the Harmony network. It enables automated trade allocation, matching, confirmation, give-up messaging, and reporting across FX, equities, equity derivatives, and exchange-traded derivatives. Harmony connects market participants for same-day trade processing with low-latency matching and confirmation workflows.
